tools.description: List the marketplace orders of a project, newest first. Filters combine with AND; dates are read as UTC. tools.name: channable_get_order
tools.description: One order with its customer, addresses, items, status, fulfillments and event log. order_id is the Channable order id (the id field from channable_list_orders). GET /v2/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: channable_ship_order
tools.description: Set an order to shipped, with tracking data. Give transporter as a Channable transporter code (channable_list_transporters lists them) and tracking_code. Pass order_item_ids to ship only some items (the order then becomes partial; repeat with the other items later); omit it to ship the whole order.

tools.name: channable_cancel_order
tools.description: Seller-side cancellation: set an order to cancelled. Pass order_item_ids to cancel only some items (the order then becomes partial); omit it to cancel the whole order. Amazon, Cdiscount and Spartoo do not support partial cancellations. A buyer-side cancellation must be confirmed in the marketplace s

tools.description: Tell Channable that you handle this order yourself: Channable takes no further action on it (no status updates to the marketplace). tools.name: channable_create_return
tools.description: Manually create a return on the marketplace for products of an order. Only Fruugo, Otto, Veepee and Zalando support this. products lists the product ids (the item id of the order), the quantity and optionally accepted or rejected. POST /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/orders/{order_id}/ret

tools.name: channable_list_returns
tools.description: List the returns of a project, newest first. Dates are read as UTC. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. Reply: returns, error_count, count, next_offset. GET /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/returns.

tools.name: channable_get_return
tools.description: One return with its item, reason, customer, status and log. return_id is the id field from channable_list_returns. GET /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/returns/{return_id}.

tools.name: channable_update_return_status
tools.description: Set the status of a return: accepted, rejected, repaired, keeps, exchanged, cancelled. Depending on the status the customer does or does not get their money back (accepted and cancelled differ from rejected). POST /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/returns/{return_id}/status. tools.name: channable_list_stock_updates
tools.description: List the offers (product stock updates) that were posted to a project, newest first: id, stock, price, title, GTIN. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. Reply: offers, count, next_offset. GET /v1/companies/{company}/projects/{project}/offers.

tools.name: channable_update_stock
tools.description: Set the stock of up to 50 offers. Each item is the offer id as the marketplaces know it, plus the WHOLE new stock value (not a delta). Pass order_config_id (the order_config_id field of an order) for one order connection only. GET /v1/companies/{company}/proj

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: channable_ship_order, channable_cancel_order, channable_mark_order_manual, channable_create_return, channable_update_return_status, channable_update_stock · Public sink: channable_ship_order, channable_cancel_order, channable_mark_order_manual, channable_create_return, channable_update_return_status, channable_update_stock.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: channable_ship_order, channable_cancel_order, channable_mark_order_manual, channable_create_return, channable_update_return_status, channable_update_stock · Public sink: channable_ship_order, channable_cancel_order, channable_mark_order_manual, channable_create_return, channable_update_return_status, channable_update_stock

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
